text: Only 503 of these exist, because NASCAR said build 500 or stay home. So Dodge built the minimum, then hung a wing on the trunk. It sat 23 inches up, and no, that was not so the trunk would open. It was reaching for clean air. The nose came to a point, the rear window went flat, and that shape hit 200 miles per hour. Then the cars sat unsold on dealer lots. Would you drive a car built to beat a rule? Tell me below.
